title: T1 Energy Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: T1 Energy Inc. completed a $184 million convertible senior notes offering on April 17, 2026, with 4.00% coupon maturing in 2031. Net proceeds of approximately $174.7 million will fund construction of a solar cell manufacturing facility in Austin, Texas with 2.1 GW capacity.
key_points: T1 Energy Inc. issued $184.0 million aggregate principal amount of 4.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031
Net proceeds estimated at $174.7 million after underwriting discounts and offering expenses
Proceeds allocated to Phase 1 construction of G2_Austin solar cell fabrication facility (2.1 GW capacity)
Initial conversion rate: 146.9724 shares per $1,000 principal (conversion price ~$6.80, representing 40% premium to $4.86 stock price on April 14, 2026)
Notes bear interest payable semi-annually on April 15 and October 15, beginning October 15, 2026
Company targeting additional debt financing to fund remaining Phase 1 capital expenditures
